capabilities: Add a clickable title bar with chevron to fold and unfold note embeds
Fold embedded notes by default using a trailing-dash embed syntax
Set a global default so all embedded notes start collapsed
Remember fold state per session, separately for reading mode and Live Preview
extras: README documents limitations in detail (whole-line marker rule in Live Preview, per-line fold tracking, note embeds only) and describes a Playwright-based E2E test suite; the manifest notes the plugin has not been manually reviewed by Obsidian staff.
problem: Obsidian renders embedded notes fully expanded with no way to collapse them, which clutters notes with many embeds.
summary: Adds clickable fold/unfold title bars to note embeds in reading view and Live Preview, with a trailing-dash syntax to fold by default.
